prompt: What is the name of the steel roller coaster that most recently lost its title as the tallest operating steel roller coaster in the world?
answer: **Top Thrill 2** at Cedar Point in Ohio. It held the title briefly after Kingda Ka’s closure, before losing it to **Falcons Flight** at Six Flags Qiddiya City in Saudi Arabia in December 2025.
